submission.comment: Found a strong MA crossover strategy with long_only and vol_target modifiers. The strategy uses a fast SMA of 2 days and slow SMA of 120 days, only goes long when fast > slow, and scales position by recent volatility. Achieves 1.40 annualized Sharpe with 68.5% annual return, 48.9% volatility, and 38% max drawdown on the 2018-2023 crypto data.
